about.text:
Uber Arena (formerly branded as O2 World and Mercedes-Benz Arena) is a multipurpose indoor arena in the Friedrichshain district of Berlin, Germany.

With a maximum capacity of 17,000 people for concerts and MMA events, the arena is home to the Eisbaren Berlin ice hockey team and ALBA Berlin basketball team.

Reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uber_Arena
